headline: A 2018 law renames a federal agricultural research center in Fargo, North Dakota, after former Agriculture Secretary Edward T. Schafer.
what_it_does: This law changes the official name of the Red River Valley Agricultural Research Center in Fargo, North Dakota, to the Edward T. Schafer Agricultural Research Center. It does not change the center's work, budget, or staff. The summary does not describe any other changes.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 27, 2018.
